description: A hobbyist breach kit assembled out of whatever the last owner had lying around: a cracked tablet shell, a spool of hand-soldered leads, and a fan that starts screaming the moment you ask it for anything. The seller's label, stuck on crooked, reads TWO-CELL SUPPLY: SOLD AS SEEN. It gets a signal in. It will not enjoy doing it.
name: Kessel Pry-Bar
